examples.arabic: بابا كان بده يروح ع الجبل بس ماما فضلت البحر
examples.english: My dad wanted to go to the mountain but my mom preferred the sea.
examples.transliteration: baba kan biddo yrouh a aljabal bas mama faddalat albahr

examples.arabic: بابا فكر شوي وقال لازم نلاقي حل سريع للحمة والخضرة
examples.english: Dad thought a bit and said we need to find a quick solution for the meat and vegetables.
examples.transliteration: Baba fakkar shway w qal lazim nlaqi hall saree' lal lahme w el khodra.

examples.arabic: رامي ما بيوقف اسئلة وبس يشوف ابوه بقوله السلام عليكم بابا ليش ما اكلت معنا
examples.english: Rami doesn't stop asking questions, and when he sees his father, he says, "Peace be upon you dad, why didn't you eat with us?"
examples.transliteration: Rami ma biwaqqif as'ila w bas yishouf abuh bi'ullu as-salāmu ʿalaykum baba leish ma akalt ma'na

examples.english: We are sitting at the cafe and waiting for Dad.
examples.transliteration: Niḥna qaʿdiin bil kafe w mnestanna baba.

examples.arabic: بابا جاب قهوة وشاي للكل بعد المباراة
examples.english: Dad brought coffee and tea for everyone after the game.
examples.transliteration: Baba jab gahwe w shay lil-kull ba3d il-mubaara

examples.arabic: بابا جاب عدة صغيرة من الخزانة
examples.english: Dad brought a small toolbox from the cupboard.
examples.transliteration: Baba jab edde zghireh min el khzaneh.
